title: Usage-cohort-driven model priority simulator & procurement protocol
text:
Usage-cohort-driven model priority simulator & procurement protocol

description:
Build a decision-support simulator that translates observed customer usage cohorts (short-burst, steady-throughput, spike-driven, infra-sensitive) into prioritized model-provisioning recommendations (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private), procurement triggers, and suggested SLA bundling. This ticket scopes the research, simulation engine, experiment plan, and a lightweight protocol for Solutions/Sales to recommend provisioning options to prospects.

deliverables:
Cohort taxonomy & instrumentation spec (event hooks + telemetry signals)
Simulator prototype (Python/R notebook + configurable workload generator)
Cost-latency tradeoff matrices per cohort and per target region/hardware profile
Procurement protocol: automated recommendation card + gating heuristics for sales ops
Field probe plan to validate simulator on three pilot customers and internal sandbox

acceptance_criteria:
Simulator maps 4 canonical cohorts to plausible provisioning mixes with estimated monthly cost delta and median tail latency (p50/p95)
Recommendation card generates a clear procurement trigger (e.g., monthly tokens > X or p95 latency > Y) and a suggested SKU mix
Pilot customers agree simulator recommendations match observed perf/cost within +/-20% over 30-day run
All artifacts documented in Confluence and handed off to Solutions + Sales Ops

risks:
Telemetry gaps in customer events could bias cohort labels
Pilot customers unwilling to share sufficient telemetry (NDA/legal friction)
Cost model sensitivity to GPU spot pricing produces wide recommendation variance

next_steps:
Complete instrumentation spec and validate with sandbox telemetry (owner: Research, due 2025-03-14)
Finish simulator prototype and open internal evaluation (owner: Ethan, due 2025-03-28)
Prepare recommendation card mockups and integrate into Solutions playbook (owner: Design + Solutions, due 2025-03-21)
Schedule pilot outreach with 3 sales-ready prospects and secure NDAs (owner: Sales Ops, due 2025-03-31)

comments:
2025-02-12 Priya G: Kickoff — aligned with research/infra to reuse recent synthetic workload harness. Initial hypothesis: many SMB customers with bursty traffic prefer hosted with burst reserve; mid-market often benefit from hybrid dedicated bursts.
2025-02-18 Ethan W: Pulled in SRE and Finance for cost modeling. Decided to model three hardware tiers (A100-80GB, H100-80GB, edge T4-like) and two quant profiles (fp16, int8).
2025-02-25 Research: Prototype generator that replays anonymized telemetry from internal sandbox (sanitized) and produces cohort labels. Early results show steady-throughput cohort has 2.3x better unit cost on dedicated under sustained load.
2025-03-01 Design review: recommendation card UI needs to show uncertainty bands and clear next steps (contracting lead, expected onboarding time). Action: DES-1024 to mock card in console
2025-03-04 Ethan W: Blocker noted — legal flagged data retention requirements for pilot customers. Added security_review_required = true for pilot artifacts. Added dependency on PM-47289 for pilot NDA checklist.
